CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_corporate_assignments (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  corporateCode VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  assignedBy INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_user_corporate_user (userId),
  INDEX idx_user_corporate_code (corporateCode),
  UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_corporate_unique (userId, corporateCode)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_factory_assignments (

  factoryCode VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  assignedBy INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_user_factory_user (userId),
  INDEX idx_user_factory_code (factoryCode),
  UNIQUE INDEX idx_user_factory_unique (userId, factoryCode)
);
